category_edits.rationale: Double the baseline context length for all four datasets to capture recurring preferences. Existing sampling, validation and predictor code preserve chronological order, right alignment and recent-history truncation. The positional table and predictor automatically use the enlarged length through MAXLEN and checkpoint metadata. Preserve the required 200-epoch cap and environment-provided data directory.

change_summary: Increase default context from 128 to 256 with matching positional-table and prediction lengths. Retain one SASRec model per dataset, existing causal masking, loss, optimizer and routing.
